summary: Germany's flag carrier, based in Cologne with hubs in Frankfurt and Munich.
checkin: Online and app check-in opens 30 hours before departure (on some routes later).
baggage: A carry-on can weigh up to 8 kg and measure 55 x 40 x 23 cm. On European routes the cheapest fares include no checked bag, and Economy Light covers only a personal item (40 x 30 x 15 cm) under the seat; a carry-on can be added for a fee.
tips: Check your fare's allowance before packing; it differs between European and long-haul routes.
Online check-in also works for flights operated by SWISS and Austrian.
